purpose: Batch 27 adds two unique high-confidence internet-reverified examples using primary auction records plus official company, operator and public-body corroboration. No exact title or INSPIRE parcel join is inferred.

candidates.address: Pizza Express, 50 Blue Boar Row, Salisbury, Wiltshire, SP1 1DA
candidates.title: Freehold restaurant investment let to PizzaExpress (Restaurants) Limited
candidates.lease_position: Acuitus states a 15-year lease from 27 May 2019, no breaks, a 27 May 2029 rent review and expiry on 26 May 2034. The executed lease and current rent-payment evidence were not opened.
candidates.epc_position: Acuitus states EPC Band D. The exact certificate was not opened from the official register.
candidates.occupation_position: PizzaExpress's official location page and the Food Standards Agency record both identify the operating restaurant at 50 Blue Boar Row.
candidates.planning_position: Existing restaurant occupation is corroborated, but lawful-use history, listed-building status, alterations, planning conditions and building-control records were not read.
risk_notes: guide price is not published and the lot remains marked Available after the 16 July 2026 auction
the title register, title plan, legal pack, executed occupational lease, rent-payment history, EPC certificate and exact parcel geometry remain unread
Companies House confirms the tenant company is active but does not prove lease performance or property ownership

candidates.title: Freehold retail investment with four-flat prior-approval development opportunity
candidates.tenant: JG FOODS LIMITED t/a Grape Tree
candidates.lease_position: Acuitus states a ten-year lease from 29 September 2022 at £25,000 per annum with a tenant break on 29 September 2027. The executed lease, break notice position and rent-payment evidence were not opened.
candidates.planning_position: Acuitus states prior approval was granted by Stafford Borough Council on 26 March 2026 for conversion of the first and second floors to four self-contained apartments. The official public-access route and reference are recorded, but the application summary, decision notice and approved plans were not opened.
candidates.occupation_position: JG Foods Limited is active at Companies House, Grape Tree identifies JG Foods Limited as the operator, and the Food Standards Agency record identifies Grape Tree at 55 Greengate Street.
candidates.epc_position: Acuitus states the EPC is available in the legal pack. The legal pack and official certificate were not opened.
risk_notes: the tenant break on 29 September 2027 materially limits the headline lease term
prior approval is not treated as full planning permission and the official decision notice and drawings remain unread
title register, title plan, legal pack, lease, EPC, rates, access rights, development constraints and exact parcel geometry remain pending
